label: Controls for the LIVING_2-to-LIVING_1 route at the Dei Filius root, checked
description: Nonvacuity: STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES and the restricted sense bridge are jointly satisfiable with a living pure act. Sense mixing fails without the bridge: a pure act can have life at some time (LIVING_2) and not LIVING_1, so STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES alone does not give the living conjunct. The bridge alone gives a pure act no LIVING_1: with no life at any time the bridge holds and a pure act does not live. This does not check that STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES is needed in the full premise bundle of either composition (no omission model for those bundles is checked). The restriction matters: the unrestricted bridge implies the restricted one, which can hold where the unrestricted one fails. The new route does not formally presuppose the old intellect-gives-life bridge (its source warrant still runs through intellect: q.18 a.3 grounds God's life in his understanding). Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only; they show where each premise is needed, not that it is false or doubtful.
